agent.problem: The line "An enemy David can take" reuses Psalm 55:12, where David says he could endure an enemy's insult, but the card cites only Psalm 55:13-14. The citation needs to include verse 12, or that clause needs to be removed.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
